BDX.thesis_one_line: Standalone medical-device leader for needles, IV lines and hospital dispensing, raising guidance every quarter since its spin-off but still fixing FDA quality problems.
kill_criteria: A new FDA Warning Letter, Form 483, or consent-decree expansion covering any BD manufacturing site within the next 4 quarters.
Full-year FY26 adjusted diluted EPS guidance is cut (vs. the current $12.62-$12.72 range) at any future quarterly release.
Organic/reported revenue growth falls below the 'low single-digit' floor of guidance for two consecutive quarters.
Net debt/EBITDA (consolidated) rises above 3.0x (from ~2.1x currently), signalling debt-funded buybacks outrunning deleveraging.
Any voluntary or FDA-mandated recall of a top-5-revenue product line (e.g., BD Alaris, Pyxis, ChloraPrep, or a BioPharma Systems platform).
key_adverse_facts: Live, unresolved FDA quality-system issues: CareFusion 303/Pyxis Form 483 (May 2024) and Warning Letter (Nov 2024, San Diego Dispensing QMS); separate El Paso Warning Letter unresolved as of the Q2 FY26 10-Q, with BD voluntarily adjusting the ChloraPrep line pending resolution and disclosing potential recall risk.

Q2 FY26 GAAP net loss of $(311)M / $(1.11) diluted EPS, driven by a $450M non-cash asset impairment (all segments) plus a $(274)M net-of-tax loss from discontinued operations tied to the Waters spin-off close.

~6,995 pending hernia-mesh product-liability claims as of March 31, 2026, essentially flat versus 6,905 a year earlier despite a FY2024 settlement of the majority of prior claims; $52-63M pre-tax legal/product charges recorded in a single recent quarter.
Goodwill ($25.9B) exceeds total stockholders' equity ($24.4B), a legacy of the Bard/CareFusion acquisition era.
data_conflicts: Vendor-aggregated (Yahoo/d4) TTM free cash flow of $4.48B mixes pre-spin (consolidated, including the now-divested Biosciences segment) and post-spin quarters and materially overstates New BD's standalone run-rate; this dossier uses a normalised ~$2.2-2.3B FCF run-rate (annualised from the 9-month continuing-operations cash flow disclosed in the Q3 FY26 10-Q) for valuation instead. A downstream valuation agent using the raw $4.48B figure would derive an implausible (negative) implied growth rate.
BDX.confidence_in_thesis: medium - the quarterly guidance-raise trend and cash-flow acceleration are well evidenced, but only two clean post-spin quarters exist and the FDA quality-system remediation outcome is genuinely unresolved

valuation_view_vs_v1.reconciliation: No V1 row exists for BDX (checked v1_valuation_table.csv and v1_valuation.json); this dossier's own reverse DCF, using a normalised New BD FCF run-rate rather than the distorted vendor TTM figure, finds the market pricing in a 5.6-7.0% 10-year FCF/EPS CAGR at a 7.5-8.0% WACC, in line with BD's own mid-single-digit-revenue-plus-margin-expansion algorithm.

BDX.scenario_basis: Starting normalised New BD FCF run-rate ~$2.3B (annualised from 9-month continuing-ops cash flow, Q3 FY26 10-Q) and FY26 adjusted EPS guidance midpoint ~$12.67; base case assumes 6-7% FCF/EPS growth with a stable ~14x forward multiple and 2.3% dividend yield; bear assumes an FDA-driven recall/guidance cut with the multiple compressing to ~12x; bull assumes clean execution plus re-rating toward peer med-tech multiples (~17-18x).

CARR.thesis_one_line: Global air-conditioning and refrigeration leader riding a real data-center cooling order boom, but core growth just turned positive and debt is the highest among HVAC peers.
kill_criteria: Data-center segment orders growth decelerates below +50% YoY for two consecutive quarters (from the current +300-500% pace).
Net debt/EBITDA (consolidated, using guided adjusted operating profit as the EBITDA proxy) rises above 3.5x (from ~3.0x currently).
FY26 adjusted EPS guidance is cut from the current ~$2.90 at any future quarterly release.
Core (non-data-center) organic growth falls back below 0% for two consecutive quarters after the Q2 2026 +3% print.
Free cash flow for FY26 comes in below the guided ~$2.0 billion.
key_adverse_facts: Net debt grew to $10.6B (Jun 30, 2026) from $10.3B (Dec 31, 2025) even as guidance was raised, driven by a 23% YoY rise in accounts receivable (vs. ~4% sales growth) consistent with data-center-ramp working-capital consumption; FY26 free-cash-flow guidance (~$2B) was left unchanged despite the sales/EPS raise.

Adjusted operating margin compressed ~190bps YoY in Q2 2026 (17.2% vs. 19.1%) in the very quarter that produced the guidance raise; adjusted EPS FELL year on year in Q4-25 ($0.34 vs $0.54), Q1-26 ($0.57 vs $0.65) and Q2-26 ($0.86 vs $0.92) [DV07 correction 2026-10-08: the earlier text said EPS growth was driven by share count].

Riello divestiture closed July 1, 2026, one quarter later than the 'end of Q2 2026' target restated in the Q1 2026 release (itself already a slip from the original 'end of Q1 2026' target) - a minor management-credibility flag on disclosed timelines.
Net debt/EBITDA (consolidated) at ~3.0-3.4x depending on EBITDA basis is the highest among the named HVAC peer set (Trane Technologies, Lennox).
data_conflicts: [DV07 correction 2026-10-08] The earlier 'TTM FCF ~$0.86B' was wrong: TTM free cash flow is $1,928M (FY25 $2,121M - H1-25 $988M + H1-26 $795M); there is no negative-Q1 distortion.
CARR.confidence_in_thesis: medium - the data-center order growth and guidance raises are well verified against primary filings, but conversion of orders/backlog into recognised revenue and margin is not yet proven over multiple quarters

valuation_view_vs_v1.reconciliation: [DV07 restated 2026-10-08] No V1 row exists for CARR. Programme-basis reverse DCF (equity, Ke 9.7% = 5.17% + Blume beta 1.09 x 4.14%, FCF after SBC, 10 years then 3.0%): the price implies about 9.0%/yr on guided FY26 FCF ($1.9bn after SBC) and 9.5%/yr on TTM FCF $1,853M, at the upper edge of the 7-9% base range (original: 7.0% at 8.0% WACC against EV). implied_vs_base kept as in_line (upper edge).

CARR.scenario_basis: Starting FY26 guided adjusted EPS ~$2.90 and guided FCF ~$2.0B; base case assumes high-single-digit adjusted EPS growth as data-center orders convert to revenue and core stabilises, with the multiple holding near the current ~17.6x NTM P/E; bear assumes data-center order deceleration and continued margin compression with the multiple falling toward ~13x; bull assumes sustained data-center demand and margin recovery with re-rating toward peer (TT/LII) multiples in the low-20s.

CCL.thesis_one_line: World's largest cruise line, delivering twelve straight quarters of record demand and deleveraging to investment grade, still carrying $23 billion of debt with earnings due in days.
kill_criteria: Net debt/adjusted EBITDA (as disclosed by the company) rises back above 3.5x (from 3.1x currently), reversing the deleveraging trend.
FY26 adjusted net income guidance is cut in dollar terms (not just a yield-metric trim) from the current ~$3.5-3.6B range at the Q3 (2026-09-29) or any subsequent release.
Constant-currency net yield growth turns negative for any full quarter (from the current guided +1.75-2.25% for FY26).
Customer deposits decline year-over-year (from the current all-time-high $9.0B).
A new material Middle East/Red Sea-style routing disruption forces redeployment of a second major itinerary region within the next four quarters.
key_adverse_facts: FY26 constant-currency net-yield guidance was trimmed at the Q2 2026 release (to +1.75-2.25% from +2.5-3.0% guided in December 2025), driven by a forced Middle East/Arabian Gulf redeployment and loyalty-program accounting changes - a genuine guidance walk-back that a single fuel-cost-focused news article (triage's source) did not capture.

Still-unresolved DOJ/EPA Clean Water Act notice (issued March 14, 2022) for alleged vessel-discharge violations, disclosed as unresolved in the Q2 FY26 10-Q - a repeat-pattern environmental-compliance risk given Carnival's 2016-2022 environmental-crimes probation history.
Long-term debt remains $23.4 billion in absolute dollar terms even after deleveraging; gross-margin yields were down 3.9% YoY in Q2 2026 on fuel-price inflation.
Two purported COVID-era class actions (Australia, Italy) remain pending, though the company continues to expect no material impact.
Next earnings (Q3 FY26) are due 2026-09-29, three days after this dossier's cutoff, so the freshest quarter and any updated FY26 guidance are not reflected here.
data_conflicts: d4/Yahoo forwardEps (~$2.59) sits meaningfully below the ~$3.0+ adjusted EPS a straight-line reading of management's own ~$3.5-3.6B FY26 adjusted-net-income guidance divided by shares outstanding implies; not resolved in this pass, flagged for the valuation agent.
Triage's cited net debt/EBITDA of 3.3x is stale versus the company's own Q2 2026 disclosed 3.1x (down from ~3.7x a year earlier) - deleveraging continued between triage and this diligence pass.
CCL.confidence_in_thesis: medium - the multi-year demand and deleveraging trend is well evidenced and independently confirmed by two rating agencies, but leverage remains high in absolute terms and Q3 FY26 results/guidance land after this dossier's cutoff

valuation_view_vs_v1.reconciliation: No V1 row exists for CCL (checked v1_valuation_table.csv and v1_valuation.json); this dossier's own reverse DCF at a 9.5% WACC (reflecting CCL's high beta and leverage) finds the market pricing in 7.7% (normalised FCF) to 11.4% (trailing FCF) 10-year FCF CAGR; the normalised reading sits at or below management's own PROPEL near-term target pace (~10.7%/yr through 2029), supporting an in-line read, while the trailing-FCF reading would argue the market is pricing in more than the base case.

CCL.scenario_basis: Starting FY26 guided adjusted net income ~$3.5-3.6B (~1.15B shares) and FY26 net-yield/cost guidance as of the Q2 2026 release; base case assumes continued deleveraging toward ~2.7x net debt/EBITDA, mid-single-digit yield growth and multiple re-rating from 8.8x toward ~10-11x NTM P/E; bear assumes a demand shock or further itinerary disruption with the multiple compressing toward ~7x; bull assumes PROPEL targets are met or exceeded with re-rating toward RCL-like multiples (~12-13x).
